Definition: Nearjah, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Neariah is one of the six sons of Shemaiah in the line of the royal family of David after the captivity, and another Neariah is a captain of the Simeonites who drives the Amalekites from Mount Seir. Both men carry the same name into different parts of the story, and both are kept in the record.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the lists keep what the stories forget: two men with one name, one in the king's line and one on the battlefield, both written down because God counts His people by name.
RelatedPeople: Neariah, Son of Shemaiah; Neariah, Son of Ishi
